title: Setup wizard

prompt.message: Use the setup wizard to quickly configure language, your identity, theme, and more.

changeableHint: You can change this later anytime in Settings.

intro.title: Welcome 👋
intro.body: Let's quickly set up a few things to make Atlas comfortable to use. You can skip any step, and change everything later in Settings.

identity.title: My identity
identity.desc: Registering your name makes the TODO (My work) view and auto journal work around you.
identity.changeable: You can change this later in Settings > Behavior > My identity.

taskView.title: Tasks tab default view
taskView.desc: The view shown by default when opening the monitoring 'Tasks' tab. Pick an example below.

theme.title: Theme
theme.desc: The overall color theme. Applied instantly when you pick one.

markdown.title: Markdown viewer
markdown.desc: Font size and line height for markdown text such as descriptions and notes.
markdown.sampleBody: An example sentence shown with bold, italic, and a list.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.minimized: Also show native toasts when the app is minimized

done.title: All set 🎉
done.body: Basic setup is done. More options such as brand, icons, backup, and shortcuts are available in Settings.
done.hint: Open Settings anytime from the bottom-left, and re-run this wizard from the top of Settings.
